title: Intuitive communicators needed for a future event

tellings.quote: and so he told me that there would be some future event where the ability to intuitively communicate would help the military and help you know command and

plain: In the early 1990s, at the headquarters of the National Security Agency (the US government's eavesdropping and code agency) in Maryland, an officer called Captain White is said to have told Dan Sherman that a future event was coming in which people able to communicate by intuition would help the military and its command. Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says the agency trained him to communicate with aliens by thought, repeats what the captain told him. If true, it would mean the government was preparing for contact.
